**Role:** Chandlery owner, Ledger keeper  
**Physical description:** Not established in the manuscript [Ch 1]  
**Personality:** Determined, curious, cautious  
**Goals:** Restore the chandlery, uncover her aunt's legacy, investigate the truth

**Arc status:** Decides to continue their dangerous work despite Wren's warnings [Ch 23]

**Name:** Tobin Gale  
**Role:** Lighthouse keeper, Wren's friend  
**Physical description:** Not established in the manuscript [Ch 11]  
**Personality:** Suspicious, secretive, relieved  
**Goals:** Get the lighthouse operational, avoid suspicion  
**Backstory summary:** Wren tracks down Tobin Gale, who has been acting suspiciously, to the small store and learns from the storekeeper that Tobin bought a lot of lamp oil on credit and seemed nervous. Wren visits the lighthouse and finds Tobin working on the lamps.  
**Arc status:** Reveals that he is keeping secrets and needs time to sort things out [Ch 11]
